requirement.description: The _normalize_path_segments function incorrectly handles path segments with dots in edge cases, particularly when dealing with non-ASCII characters and complex relative paths. This leads to test failures in test_normalize_path.py.
requirement.contract: The function should properly resolve path segments according to RFC 3986, correctly handling dots and path segments regardless of character encoding or path complexity. It should properly process sequences ending with "." or ".." to append empty string as needed.

requirement.description: The _parse_host method fails to properly validate and parse hostnames, particularly for malformed hosts like http://example.com.-example.com or IPv6 addresses with brackets. This causes failures in host validation tests.
requirement.contract: The function should correctly identify and parse IP addresses, validate hostnames, and handle edge cases such as malformed domains and IPv6 addresses with proper bracket handling.

requirement.description: URL constructor and related methods fail during setup stages of pickle-related tests, indicating issues with URL serialization/deserialization and cache management during pickling operations.
requirement.contract: The URL class should properly support pickle serialization and deserialization without corrupting internal caches or state, ensuring that unpickled objects have correct behavior and cache states.

requirement.description: Cache configuration and warning handling tests are failing, suggesting that the cache system doesn't properly handle deprecated configurations and warnings. This affects cache_configure function behavior.
requirement.contract: The cache_configure function should accept deprecated parameters with proper deprecation warnings and correctly handle cache configuration for all supported cache types.

requirement.description: URL building and modification methods fail to preserve query and fragment parameters when they should, particularly in with_suffix, with_name, and with_path methods. This impacts URL construction behavior.
requirement.contract: The URL modification methods (with_suffix, with_name, with_path) should correctly preserve query and fragment parameters when the keep_query and keep_fragment flags are set appropriately.
